name: mean_reversion_speed_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional VWAP algorithms (MF/pension fund TWAP orders, large-basket executions) continuously benchmark to session VWAP, creating a measurable mean-reverting force on price deviations. By fitting an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process to the rolling 5-minute VWAP deviation series via OLS, we estimate theta — the per-bar reversion speed. When theta > 0.05 per 5-second bar (half-life ≈ 69 seconds), it signals that active absorption is occurring: multiple institutional orders are chasing the VWAP simultaneously, and the 60-80 spot-point oscillations get pulled back to VWAP within 1-2 minutes. We enter only when theta is both high AND stable for 10+ bars, eliminating transient spikes, then trade the OU z-score extremes where the deviation has overshot the equilibrium distribution.

indicators.name: vwap_session
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset each session_date
indicators.purpose: Session VWAP — no scaling needed since it is cumulative from open. The VWAP anchor is the same regardless of bar size.

indicators.name: vwap_dev_bps
indicators.purpose: VWAP deviation normalized in bps to make OU theta dimensionless and comparable across price levels. NIFTY at 22000 — 200bps = 44 pts deviation.

indicators.name: ou_theta
indicators.formula: OLS: delta(vwap_dev_bps)[t] = -theta * vwap_dev_bps[t-1] + intercept; theta = -slope. Window=60 bars.
indicators.purpose: 60 bars = 5 minutes at 5s resolution. This is the minimum for OLS reliability (58 observations for 2-parameter fit) while being short enough to detect intraday regime changes. The original used 60 1-min bars (60 min) — we compress because we hold 30-120s, not 10-30 min. The OU estimation must match our hold horizon: if half-life >> hold time, we cannot profit from the reversion.

indicators.name: ou_sigma
indicators.formula: std(OLS residuals) from ou_theta regression, same 60-bar window
indicators.purpose: Diffusion parameter needed to compute the OU equilibrium standard deviation (sigma / sqrt(2 * theta)), which normalizes the deviation into a z-score.

indicators.name: ou_zscore
indicators.purpose: Z-score normalized by the OU equilibrium distribution — NOT a simple rolling z-score. When ou_theta is high, the equilibrium std is small, making the z-score larger for the same absolute deviation. This ensures we only trade when deviation is extreme RELATIVE TO the current reversion regime.

indicators.name: theta_stable_10
indicators.purpose: 10 bars = 50 seconds of sustained high theta. Eliminates single-bar theta spikes from noisy OLS fits, requiring the mean-reverting force to be consistently present before entry.

conditions: ou_theta > theta_min (default 0.05 per 5s bar → half-life ≈ 69s, within hold horizon)
theta_stable_10: theta > theta_min*0.6 for all 10 preceding bars (regime stability)
ou_zscore < -zscore_entry (default -2.0: price significantly below VWAP in OU model terms)
vix < 22 (mean-reversion breaks down in high-volatility regimes)
buy_ce.confirmation: ou_theta must have been > 0.6 * theta_min for 10 consecutive bars

buy_pe.confirmation: same theta stability requirement as buy_ce

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts (≈8 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5). If ou_zscore worsens toward 3.0 from an entry at 2.0, the deviation has increased by ~50% of the entry level — meaning the OU model is wrong about current theta or the process is not mean-reverting right now. NIFTY's typical 1-minute move of 3-7 option pts calibrates 4 pts as tight but not hair-trigger.
exit.target_rationale: 6 option pts (≈12 NIFTY spot pts). A z-score of 2.0 in OU equilibrium terms corresponds to ~15-25 bps VWAP deviation on NIFTY (~33-55 spot pts). Full reversion to z=0 covers the full deviation; we target 6 pts capturing ~50% of the expected move at 1:1.5 R:R, allowing 4-6 trades/day.

filters.vix_filter: VIX < 22 — mean-reversion breaks down when VIX is high (trend dominates, VWAP attraction weakens)
filters.time_filter: Session 09:30-15:20 IST — skip 09:15-09:29 (need 60-bar warmup for OLS + 10 bars theta stability = 70 bars = ~5.8 min after session open)
filters.volume_filter: None explicitly — NIFTY index volume on 5s bars is inherently liquid
filters.trend_filter: None — theta stability acts as implicit trend filter: in strong trends, OU theta drops (mean-reversion force weakens) and we don't trade
filters.spread_filter: Not applicable — limit order execution at candle close prices

edge.edge_decay_risk: Low — OU theta estimation for reversion speed is quantitatively distinct from the existing vwap_mean_reversion_v18/v19 (which use static z-scores). The conditional entry (only trade when theta is high AND stable) should reduce false positives significantly.

adaptation_notes: 1. Timeframe compressed from 1-min to 5s, hold from 10-30 min to 30-120s. OU window compressed from 60 min to 5 min (60 bars at 5s) because we hold 1-2 minutes, not 15-30 min — the estimation window must match our profit horizon. 2. Underlying changed from Nifty50+Next50 stock universe to NIFTY index — the VWAP mean-reversion mechanism is actually STRONGER on the index because institutional VWAP algorithms execute on the index directly (futures/options), not just individual stocks. 3. theta_min NOT directly scaled from original (0.05/1min → 0.004/5s via time-scaling would be wrong): at 5s bars we want theta that implies half-life ~60-90s (within our hold). OU half-life = ln(2)/theta_5s ≈ 69s at theta=0.01 per 5s bar. We use 0.05 as default — note the OLS estimate of theta depends on the UNITS of vwap_dev (bps here) and the bar size; this default is a starting point for optimization. 4. Z-score entry threshold kept at 2.0 — the OU z-score is dimensionless and interpretable regardless of timeframe. 5. VIX filter retained at 22 — consistent with original and appropriate for 5s index options.
weaknesses: OU theta estimation via OLS on only 60 bars is noisy — parameter uncertainty is high, especially when theta is near the threshold
On NIFTY, the 5-minute window may be too short to estimate OU parameters reliably during low-volatility sessions where VWAP deviations are very small
theta_stable_10 filter (10 bars = 50s) adds significant lag and may miss the best entry point for fast reversions
The OU model assumes constant theta and sigma within each 60-bar window — intraday, both parameters can change rapidly around news events
